We present a framework for multi-agent motion planning under legal requirements based on games with partially ordered preferences (posetal games). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics.
